children: Stocks tied to AI are having a big day amid growing enthusiasm over OpenAI's latest model, called Astra.

Shares of CoreWeave, an AI cloud infrastructure company, rose 15% Tuesday. Shares of Lumentum and Coherent, which manufacture optical and laser equipment used by AI data centers, were up 12% and 9% respectively.

Analysts say the Astra model, released last week, represents a significant step up in AI's ability to find its own resources to solve a problem. Its ability to devise and execute novel cyberattacks led OpenAI to limit some of the model's capabilities before public release.
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).
